subject: [PATCH v3 11/11] scsi: mpt3sas: Time out delayed not-responding device blocks

2026-11-18.patch_summary: This patch addresses a deadlock issue in the mpt3sas driver where delayed not-responding device blocks can cause scan attempts to hang indefinitely. The patch introduces a new mechanism to schedule a work item that unblocks expired sdevs after a delay, ensuring that devices are not blocked for too long and preventing deadlocks. The patch also improves handling of PCIe missing delays and ensures that offline sdevs are not put into a timed block state. Additionally, it updates the driver to give new deadlines to sdevs still blocked after a hard reset.
